newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HORSE RACING-TRAINER HUTCHISON SERIOUSLY HURT IN CAR CRASH.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-TRAINER HUTCHISON SERIOUSLY HURT IN CAR CRASH.

text.p: Australian horse trainer Bruce Hutchison was seriously injured in a car crash in Hong Kong on Wednesday, a spokesman for the Hong Kong Jockey Club said.

The 54-year-old trainer suffered severe head injuries and heavy bleeding when his car ran into a barrier along a highway on Hong Kong's Kowloon peninsula in the early hours of the morning, the spokesman said. No other vehicle was involved.
"He is in intensive care with very bad head injuries after he ran into the barrier. We don't know more at this stage," the spokesman said.
A police spokesman confirmed the injuries and said that Hutchison, who has been training in Hong Kong for some years, was still conscious. No further details were immediately available.
